en.title: Observing the partial lunar eclipse in Irbid on Tuesday, 16 July 2019, at 9 pm
en.excerpt: Observing the partial lunar eclipse in Irbid on Tuesday, 16 July 2019, at 9 pm at Blooming Academy, in cooperation with AUASS and the Jordanian Astronomical Society.
en.body:
Observing the partial lunar eclipse in Irbid

Tuesday, 16 July 2019, at 9 pm
at Blooming Academy
in cooperation with the Arab Union for Astronomy and Space Sciences and the Jordanian Astronomical Society.
Irbid, south of Sahara roundabout, opposite Qasr Al-Awadeen
